notes: Layered on stocks-long.json (--args A --args B): adds the keyed feature families built by workflow-features.json (stock-daily-features / stock-option-trade-features sources, onboarded as localfiles stores). Declared separately so the base overlay plans before those tables exist; the families are admitted by step 3 like any other. Source/stream/field names must agree with workflow-features.json args.tables and daily_features/trade_features fields.

volume_liquidity.lookback: 22-session trailing volume windows ending at the entry date's own bar
volume_liquidity.clock_note: same-day: the entry decision is taken at the close that defines the bar, so the bar is known

market_relative.lookback: 1/5/22-session return minus the benchmark's, 66-session beta and correlation to it, all ending at the entry date's close
